name: YNX Search
title: YNX Search — Transparent Search for the YNX Web4 Ecosystem
metaDescription: Search reviewed YNX products, documentation, releases, public chain evidence, governance and authorized public sources with visible citations, freshness and correction paths.
h1: Search YNX with sources you can verify
status: Central candidate; historical public Testnet preview remains online
features: reviewed source registry with explicit public data classes
source, data class and freshness visibility
hash-verified backup, separate-path restore and deterministic public reindex
Request, Trace and Error correlation with bounded structured logs
protected Prometheus metrics and reproducible local capacity evidence
provider-neutral external Search adapter with explicit outage and retention boundaries
exact centrally accepted Web Wallet registration for correction and appeal cases
truthBoundaries: YNX Search covers only registered and authorized sources.
It does not claim global web coverage, neutrality or complete protection from abuse.
External provider and AI results are separate from the YNX index.
The older public preview is online, but its Wallet, AI and Trust gateways report unavailable.
The current central source commit is not yet deployed to staging or the public route.

faq.question: What does YNX Search index?
faq.answer: Only sources registered with an owner, authorization, permitted scope, terms, data rights, explicit reviewed public data classes, retention and correction paths. Private messages, mail, files, Wallet sessions, secrets, internal engineering data and operator logs are rejected.

faq.question: Does YNX Search control Google or Bing ranking?
faq.answer: No. It is an independent YNX product for ecosystem and authorized-source search. Website and documentation owners control external SEO submissions.

faq.question: Can the AI answer without sources?
faq.answer: No. Search AI is limited to the current retrieved set, requires explicit consent and rejects citations outside that set.

faq.question: How can a result be corrected or removed?
faq.answer: The product provides auditable correction, removal and appeal requests. Central Trust integration is still pending.
